register.labelZh: DIVIDE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: 學懂這些 DIVIDE 表達後,你便能正確理解和使用 divide 48 by 6 和 divide 6 into 48。；divide something up 能幫助你說明如何把某事物分配給不同的人。；divide up into 可以描述學生分隊、客人分行,或把事物分成較小部分。；divide something off 可以描述簾、牆、屏風或圍欄如何把一個地方與另一個地方分隔開。
register.summaryEn: DIVIDE expressions allow you to understand and use both divide 48 by 6 and divide 6 into 48 correctly. Divide something up helps you explain how something is shared fairly between or among people. Divide up into can describe students forming teams, guests forming lines or something being separated into smaller parts. Divide something off can describe how a curtain, wall, screen or fence separates one area from another.

contextsEn: Talk about mathematical division without reversing the numbers
Talk about sharing work, money, food and time
Organise people and things into groups
